story: Zoe and Raj are in a science class. They look at an old, green book. Zoe wears her glasses to read the long words slowly. Raj carries a very special lunch. The lunch has cheese and meat. Raj has short hair and kind eyes. Raj must pay for his food. He makes a call to a Japanese friend.
title: A Science Class Lunch
setting: A bright classroom with desks and books.

characters.name: Zoe
characters.look: A girl with short black hair and round glasses.

characters.name: Raj
characters.look: A boy with short brown hair and a blue shirt.

sentences.en: Zoe and Raj study science in class.
sentences.scene_prompt: Zoe and Raj sit at a desk in a bright classroom.

sentences.en: They look at an old, green book.
sentences.zh: 他们看一本又旧又绿的书。
sentences.scene_prompt: Zoe and Raj look at an old green book on the desk.

sentences.en: Zoe wears her glasses to read.
sentences.scene_prompt: Zoe with short black hair wears round glasses and looks at a book.

sentences.en: Zoe reads the long words slowly.
sentences.zh: Zoe缓慢地读着那些长的单词。
sentences.scene_prompt: Zoe points her finger at a word in the book.

sentences.en: Raj carries a very special lunch.
sentences.zh: Raj端着一份非常特别的午餐。
sentences.scene_prompt: Raj with short brown hair carries a small white plate.

sentences.en: The lunch has cheese and meat.
sentences.scene_prompt: A close up of a plate with yellow cheese and red meat.

sentences.en: Raj has short hair and kind eyes.
sentences.zh: Raj有短头发和善良的眼睛。
sentences.scene_prompt: A close up of Raj's face showing his short hair and a kind smile.

sentences.en: Raj must pay for his food.
sentences.scene_prompt: Raj puts a coin on the table near his lunch.

sentences.en: He makes a call to a Japanese friend.
sentences.zh: 他给一位日本朋友打了个电话。
sentences.scene_prompt: Raj holds a phone to his ear and smiles.
